primary.why: 0 A.D. is a free, open-source historical RTS under active development by Wildfire Games. The current release is Release 28: Boiorix, so the archive route should use the current desktop release and record exact version.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current official desktop build from play0ad.com or the official itch.io page. Record version number, OS, mods, civilization, map, AI/multiplayer settings, and whether the run targets a historical alpha or current release.
